agent_explanation: Floor bounce at step 90->91 injects energy: incoming speed ~18.34 (energy ~176 J) rebounds to ~28.96 (energy ~427 J) despite e=0.5 (should reduce) and even e=0 still gains energy (176->203 J). Gravity work is near-zero over 0.06s, no controller work, so gain violates 10%+5J tolerance. Counterfactual raising initial height to avoid ground contact in 91 steps removes violation, proving bounce is causal. Likely impulse + positional correction error on arena floor (y=0) amplifies normal velocity instead of damping.
